title: Floating cargo
text: Barrels bob in the swell, the wreck that spilled them nowhere in sight.

outcomes.text: Good rum and better coin. +15 gold.
One was a powder keg. It goes off against the hull. -5 hull.
You sail on. The crew grumbles.

title: Fishing village
text: A village of stilt houses. The headman offers timber for coin.

choices.text: Buy timber and patch the hull (10 gold)

outcomes.text: Your carpenter gets to work. -10 gold, +8 hull.
They point you to a sunken chest. +10 gold.
Pleasant evening, nothing more.

title: Survivors on a raft
text: A makeshift raft, a torn sail for a flag, and a dozen sunburnt faces waving at you.

outcomes.text: Grateful sailors, eager to sign on. +10 hands.
Fever came aboard with them. +10 hands, but -10 gold for medicine.

choices.text: Toss them a water cask and sail on

outcomes.text: They curse your name as you leave.

title: A Navy sloop signals
text: A Navy sloop runs up a signal: heave to and prepare to be inspected. Your flag is not the one they're looking for. Yet.

choices.text: Bluff it out with forged papers

outcomes.text: The lieutenant squints, stamps, and waves you on. Close.
The lieutenant isn't fooled. Run out the guns!
Gold changes hands. You were never here.
No sense waiting for them to make up their minds.

title: A castaway
text: A wild-bearded figure on a spit of sand, waving a shirt on a stick. He claims to have been a ship's surgeon, before the mutiny.

outcomes.text: He was telling the truth, mostly.
He was a ship's cook. He can still swing a cleaver.

choices.text: Leave him a cask of water

outcomes.text: He curses you all the way to the horizon.

title: A Company straggler
text: A Company merchantman, her foremast sprung, wallowing alone. Her crew hasn't seen you yet.

outcomes.text: You come down on her out of the sun.

choices.text: Shadow her and let her lead you to the convoy route

outcomes.text: She limps home and you learn the Company's lanes.
She spots you and signals. Every Company ship for leagues knows your sail.

title: A ship of the dead
text: A brig drifting with her sails in rags. No one at the helm. The smell reaches you before she does.

choices.text: Send a party aboard to loot her

outcomes.text: Spices and coin, and nothing caught. Lucky.
Fever comes back with the loot.

choices.text: Let your surgeon check her first

outcomes.text: The surgeon finds the fever's source and you strip her clean.
Better safe. The crew mutter about wasted plunder.

title: Rum smugglers
text: A low schooner, gunwales almost awash with casks. Her captain hails you cheerfully: rum for sale, no questions.

outcomes.text: Fine Barbados rum, mostly.
They hand it over sullenly. Word gets around.
They'd rather fight. So be it.
The crew watch the casks go by with longing.

title: Strange waters
text: The sea boils ahead, a great slow turning of water around a dark centre.

choices.text: Steer around it, the long way

outcomes.text: A day lost, but the ship is whole.

choices.text: Trust your helmsman to skirt the edge

outcomes.text: The helmsman threads the edge like a needle. The crew cheer.
You make it, just, with spars cracking.
The current takes you. You claw free with the hull groaning.

title: A slaver's tender
text: A tender pulling hard for a slaver brig at anchor, low in the water with chained captives.

outcomes.text: You'll not let this pass.

choices.text: Cut the tender off and free who you can

outcomes.text: You take the tender without a shot. The freed men join you.
The brig sees you and slips her cable. You free the tender's few.
The crew are quiet for a long while.

title: A message in a bottle
text: Bobbing alongside: a bottle, sealed with wax. Inside, a scrap of map and a few words: 'Company payroll, three days east.'

outcomes.text: A Company pay sloop, right where it said.
Nothing there but empty sea and a wasted day.

choices.text: Sell the tip at the next port

outcomes.text: A fence pays well for a rumour.

title: Red sky at morning
text: The sky to windward is the colour of a bruise, and the glass is dropping fast.

choices.text: Shorten sail and ride it out

outcomes.text: A hard night, but you come through.

choices.text: Run before it under full sail

outcomes.text: You fly ahead of the storm and gain a day on the Company.
The storm catches you with canvas up.

choices.text: Let the bosun rig storm sails

outcomes.text: The bosun knows his trade. Barely a rope frayed.

title: A Brotherhood courier
text: A fast pinnace flying the Brotherhood's black and red. Her captain wants your help: a Navy cutter has been taking Brotherhood prizes.

outcomes.text: For the Brotherhood!

choices.text: Give him powder and shot instead

outcomes.text: He thanks you with a share of his last prize.
He sails off, disappointed.

title: Too much grog
text: Somebody broached a cask in the night. Half the watch is singing and the other half is asleep at their posts.

outcomes.text: Order is restored. Nobody's singing now.

choices.text: Let it pass, and stop their grog for a week

outcomes.text: Grumbling, but no blood.
A night to remember, for those who can.

title: Pearl divers
text: A village of pearl divers. The headman offers a pouch of pearls for help against the Company factors who take half their catch.

outcomes.text: The factors' guard boat is no match for you. The pearls are yours.
The factors had friends. A Company ship arrives.

choices.text: Trade for pearls to sell on (10 gold)

outcomes.text: A tidy profit.
Not your fight.

title: Navy deserters
text: A longboat of half-starved sailors in Navy slops. They've run from a press-gang captain and want to sign with pirates.

outcomes.text: Good seamen, glad of the chance.

choices.text: Hand them back to the Navy for the reward

outcomes.text: A bounty paid on every head. Your crew look at you differently now.

choices.text: Point them to the nearest island

outcomes.text: They wave their thanks.
